actor.reason:
REACHED THE GOAL.

What I did: added three tasks (one short, one long sentence about calling the landlord, one more short), ticked 'Buy groceries' as done, clicked the Active and Completed filters, renamed the landlord task through Edit, then tried Clear completed and finally deleted every task with the row Delete buttons.

What worked well:
- Adding a task with Enter or the Add button. The box clears and focus stays there so you can keep typing.
- Ticking the checkbox strikes the task through and the 'N left' counter updates straight away.
- Edit turns the row into a text box with a Save button. Pressing Enter saved the new name.
- Delete removes the row instantly.

What behaved differently from what I expected:
1. The Active and Completed filters are swapped. With one task ticked and two unticked, Active showed only the ticked task and Completed showed the two unticked ones. The counter still said '2 left' under both, so the list and the count disagreed.
2. My long task was silently cut off. I typed a full sentence about the landlord and the leaking tap. The list showed only 'Call the landlord about the le', and when I opened Edit the box held just those 30 characters, so the rest was thrown away with no warning or limit shown on the input.
3. Clear completed did nothing. With 'Buy groceries' ticked I clicked it twice and waited. The task stayed and the counter stayed at '2 left'. I had to use Delete instead.
4. The empty list shows the word 'undefined' in the box, both on first load and after I deleted everything. It reads like a coding error rather than a message like 'Nothing to do yet'.
5. Delete removes a task instantly with no confirmation. Fine for a small list, but a mis-click loses the task for good.

Where I hesitated: after the first Clear completed click did nothing I was not sure whether my click had registered, so I tried once more before giving up on that button. I also paused at the truncated landlord task, unsure whether the text was only clipped on screen or actually lost, until Edit confirmed it was lost.

Not verified: whether tasks survive a page reload, and whether the cut-off happens at exactly 30 characters or depends on the word.
